title: Lifted Payments Payment Statement Audit Model
description: A processor-neutral contract for normalizing statement-level merchant processing totals without cardholder or bank-account data. Cross-field accounting and privacy rules are enforced by tools/validate_audit.py.

schema_version.description: Version of this data contract. Records built against 1.1.0 remain valid under the archived 1.1.0 schema.

calculation_basis.description: Declares the numerator and denominator convention used by this release.

start.description: First calendar date covered by the statement, inclusive.

end.description: Last calendar date covered by the statement, inclusive.

currency.description: All monetary fields use US dollars. Mixed-currency records are invalid.

card_volume.description: Gross settled purchase volume for the statement period, before refunds, chargebacks, or funding adjustments.

transaction_count.description: Count of settled purchase transactions included in card_volume.

gross_processing_fees.description: Gross processing-related charges before statement_credits; equals the sum of fee_groups.

statement_credits.description: Processing-fee credits or rebates applied on the statement. Transaction refunds and funding adjustments are excluded.

total_processing_fees.description: Net processing fees: gross_processing_fees minus statement_credits.

effective_rate.description: total_processing_fees divided by card_volume, expressed as a decimal rounded to six places; null when card_volume is zero.

average_ticket.description: card_volume divided by transaction_count, rounded to cents; null when transaction_count is zero.

pricing_model.description: Observed statement pricing presentation, not a legal or qualification determination.

amex_acceptance.description: How American Express is accepted and billed. Under a direct relationship the Amex discount is billed away from this statement while its volume may still appear here, which understates the effective rate unless declared.

comparable.description: Whether this record is a sound basis for rate comparison. Required in 1.2.0. Must be false when volume is zero, undisclosed, or so small that the rate is dominated by fixed fees.

volume_disclosed.description: Whether the source statement actually printed a settled purchase volume total. False records an undisclosed volume, which is not the same fact as zero activity.

cardholder_funded_fees.description: Surcharge, service-fee, convenience-fee, or dual-price offset amounts collected from cardholders and settled inside card_volume. Required when pricing_model is dual_pricing.

merchant_borne_processing_fees.description: total_processing_fees minus cardholder_funded_fees. May be negative when a program over-recovers. Required when cardholder_funded_fees is present.

net_cost_of_acceptance_rate.description: merchant_borne_processing_fees divided by card_volume minus cardholder_funded_fees, rounded to six places; null when that base is zero. Required when cardholder_funded_fees is present.

non_recurring_fees.description: Portion of gross_processing_fees that is annual or one-time rather than monthly, such as an annual membership or a registration fee. Never subtracted from the effective rate; it is disclosed so a monthly comparison can exclude it deliberately.

recurring_effective_rate.description: total_processing_fees minus non_recurring_fees, divided by card_volume, rounded to six places; null when card_volume is zero. Required when non_recurring_fees is present.

fee_groups.description: Gross, nonnegative processing charges grouped once by category. Categories must be unique.

combined.description: True when the source statement printed this bucket inseparably combined with charges belonging to another category. Requires notes naming what was combined.

review_notes.description: Optional audit explanations only. Never include merchant identity, card data, bank data, credentials, or secrets.

money.description: A nonnegative USD amount with no more than two decimal places. Decimal precision is enforced by the companion validator.

rate.description: A nonnegative decimal rate with no more than six decimal places.

signed_money.description: A USD amount with no more than two decimal places that may be negative. Used only where over-recovery is a real outcome.

signed_rate.description: A decimal rate with no more than six decimal places that may be negative.
